fact: Decree 2015-79 of 4 February 2015, issued under law 2013-450, requires prior authorisation from the telecoms regulator ARTCI for transferring personal data to a third country that gives equal or higher protection, and sets sanctions for non-compliance (articles 6 and 8).

The Ministry of Digital Transition's national data governance strategy SNGD 2030 sets as a principle that all data classified as critical information infrastructure must be processed and stored inside Côte d'Ivoire, by staff at least 20% Ivorian, with a copy kept in the country for law enforcement; the document gives no date of its own, so its published date of 2024-01-01 is used.

The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Cote d'Ivoire as having ratified the Malabo Convention on 08/03/2023, with the instrument deposited on 03/04/2023, and no date of signature.
